theorem newHopeCmlCmiWeldedTreeInventory :
    let sourcePieceCount : Nat := 1
    let cmiPieceCount : Nat := 22
    let weldedPieceCount : Nat := 23
    let sourcePathAdjacencies : Nat := 3
    let lowerPathAdjacencies : Nat := 10
    let upperPathAdjacencies : Nat := 9
    let interPieceAdjacencyCount : Nat := 22
    let nativeOutletCount : Nat := 45
    And (sourcePieceCount + cmiPieceCount = weldedPieceCount)
      (And (sourcePathAdjacencies + lowerPathAdjacencies + upperPathAdjacencies = interPieceAdjacencyCount)
        (And (interPieceAdjacencyCount + 1 = weldedPieceCount) (nativeOutletCount = 45))) :=
by decide

theorem cmi03BifurcationInventory :
    let lowerContinuationCount : Nat := 1
    let upperContinuationCount : Nat := 1
    let cmi03OutgoingAdjacencyCount : Nat := 2
    lowerContinuationCount + upperContinuationCount = cmi03OutgoingAdjacencyCount :=
by decide

theorem boundedWeldedAdjacencyDoesNotPromoteWholeLayout :
    let sameProjectWeldedIdentityReady : Bool := true
    let sameProjectWeldedAdjacencyReady : Bool := true
    let nativeOutletAttachmentReady : Bool := true
    let exactConnectionTakeoutReady : Bool := false
    let threadedTerminalPieceAdjacencyReady : Bool := false
    let wholeProjectInterPieceAdjacencyReady : Bool := false
    let completeVerticalOffsetScheduleReady : Bool := false
    let exactWholeSystemZReady : Bool := false
    let properPipeLayoutReady : Bool := false
    let fabricationReady : Bool := false
    let fieldReleaseReady : Bool := false
    let boundedReady := sameProjectWeldedIdentityReady && sameProjectWeldedAdjacencyReady && nativeOutletAttachmentReady
    And (boundedReady = true)
      ((exactConnectionTakeoutReady || threadedTerminalPieceAdjacencyReady || wholeProjectInterPieceAdjacencyReady || completeVerticalOffsetScheduleReady || exactWholeSystemZReady || properPipeLayoutReady || fabricationReady || fieldReleaseReady) = false) :=
by decide
